title: Bauhaus in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Start with one scale.** Choose the Bauhaus-Archiv for ideas and objects, Haus Lemke for a house and garden, or the Neue Nationalgalerie for a civic-scale room.
**Do not call every clean-lined building Bauhaus.** The Neue Nationalgalerie is a later Mies van der Rohe work, not a Bauhaus school building.
**Use the current address.** The Bauhaus-Archiv is temporarily at Knesebeckstraße 1 while its original building is being renovated.
**Check the institution before travelling.** Exhibitions, entry details and opening arrangements can change, especially for a smaller venue or group visit.
Use the Berlin Bauhaus Lineage Map to see the archive, house and public hall as three different ways of reading modernism in Berlin.
